notes: The sum of the scores of the stretches ending on a night is its reading times the nights back to the last strictly colder night, plus that night's own sum; a stack of positions finds that night. Going through every stretch is right and far over budget. Multiplying the nights back by the nights on, both to a strictly colder night, counts a stretch once for each of its equal coldest nights.
